prompt:
Output the Video Scene Graph from the video and object trajectories:
<video>
Each "Object k:" block above is one tracked object of the video, with its tokens over time; the labels <a - b sec> are its time windows. Time is counted in frames, from 0 to 22.
Answer with JSON only, in exactly this form:
{"objects": [{"object 1": "<name>", "attributes": ["<attribute>", ...]}, {"object 2": "<name>", "attributes": [...]}, ...], "relationships": [[<subject object number>, "<relation>", <object number>, [[<start>, <end>], ...]], ...]}
Name every object from 1 to 15 with a short noun and list its attributes; then list every relationship (actions and spatial relations) between two of these objects, with the time spans when it holds.
